Streaming chat completion that includes a usage summary in the final chunk

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hi', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true, stream_options: { 'include_usage' => true })).to_a
puts result.inspect

```
